script.title: JOINING THE GYM
script.story_hook: A nervous beginner finds a gym that fits her life.
script.intro_zh: 一位怕進健身房的新手,找到真正適合自己的方案。
script.welcome_en: Hi! Today: asking smart questions at a gym.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來學在健身房怎麼問個清楚。
script.outro: Sixty lines, and gym sign-ups hold no traps.
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,入會細節都瞞不過你。
script.practice_intro_en: Now your turn — repeat each line with energy.
script.practice_intro_zh: 換你開口,每句話都要說得有力。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her early twenties with long straight black hair in a high ponytail, wearing a lavender tank top and matching leggings, white trainers and a smartwatch, athletic slim build, carrying a small gym bag
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man with a shaved head and a thick gray beard, wearing a red polo shirt with a gym logo, black track pants and worn trainers, broad shoulders and stocky build, holding a towel over one arm

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm just looking — is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm dʒʌst ˈlʊkɪŋ ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你好,我先隨便看看,可以嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! Tour first, then talk.
dialogue.zh: 當然!先帶你參觀,再來聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'm nervous about gyms.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我對健身房一直有點緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one's friendly, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡很親切,我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How late are you open?
dialogue.zh: 你們都開到幾點?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five a.m. to eleven p.m., daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv eɪ ˈɛm tə ɪˈlɛvən pi ˈɛm ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 每天早上五點到晚上十一點,天天開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, that fits my work days.
dialogue.zh: 很好,這跟我上班的日子對得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want to see the floor?
dialogue.zh: 要先看看器材區嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes — and is the class schedule included?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ɪz ðə klæs ˈskɛdʒul ɪnˈklʊdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 好,課程表也一併給我參考嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty classes a week — here's the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈklæsəz ə wik hɪrz ðə bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 一週二十堂課,都在這塊看板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spin, yoga, kickboxing… what suits a beginner?
dialogue.phonetic: /spɪn ˈjoʊɡə ˈkɪkˌbɑksɪŋ wʌt suts ə bɪˈɡɪnər/
dialogue.zh: 飛輪、瑜伽、拳擊有氧……哪種適合新手?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beginner yoga — slow and kind.
dialogue.zh: 初階瑜伽,動作慢,對人也溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my own mat?
dialogue.zh: 我得自己帶瑜伽墊嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We loan mats, no charge.
dialogue.zh: 我們提供借用墊子,不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Now… the scary part. Prices?
dialogue.zh: 好。再來是那可怕的部分——價格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basic plan: twenty-nine ninety-nine.
dialogue.zh: 基本方案:二十九塊九毛九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With a twelve-month contract?
dialogue.zh: 是綁十二個月的那種合約嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — or forty-five, month to month.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɔr ˈfɔrti faɪv mʌnθ tə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 對,或是四十五塊,一個月一個月繳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm. Which one do most people pick?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm wɪtʃ wʌn du moʊst ˈpipəl pɪk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯,大多數人都選哪一個?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, the yearly saves you almost two hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli ðə ˈjɪrli seɪvz ju əˈmoʊst tu ˈhʌndrəd/
dialogue.zh: 老實說,年繳可以幫你省近兩百塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I travel for work a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪ ˈtrævəl fər wərk ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 可是我常常要出差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then month-to-month — safer.
dialogue.zh: 那就選月繳的,比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I cancel? Is it a nightmare?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ˈkænsəl ɪz ɪt ə ˈnaɪtˌmɛr/
dialogue.zh: 退會麻煩嗎?會不會像惡夢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! No — thirty days' notice, done.
dialogue.zh: 哈!不會,提前三十天說一聲就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No gym police chasing me?
dialogue.zh: 不會有健身房警察追我吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only on the treadmill, and gently.
dialogue.zh: 只有在跑步機上追,而且會很溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good one! Can I freeze my account?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wʌn kæn aɪ friz maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 這個笑話好!那我可以暫停會員嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — three months a year, free.
dialogue.zh: 可以,一年可暫停三個月,免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's exactly what I need.
dialogue.zh: 這正是我需要的功能。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So — shall we try the equipment?
dialogue.zh: 那,我們去試試器材吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The machines… do they show instructions?
dialogue.zh: 那些機器……會顯示用法說明嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Screens with videos, plus me.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕有教學影片,還有我隨時在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a membership to try a class?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ˈmɛmbərʃɪp tə traɪ ə klæs/
dialogue.zh: 要先入會才能試上課程嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First week free — walk right in.
dialogue.zh: 第一週免費,直接走進教室就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, what's this line about enrollment?
dialogue.zh: 等等,這一行的入會費是什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our ad says zero dollars today.
dialogue.zh: 我們廣告寫今天入會費零元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the screen says forty-nine.
dialogue.zh: 可是螢幕上顯示四十九塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check… oh, that's my error.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk oʊ ðæts maɪ ˈɛrər/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……噢,是我設錯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It happens. So do I pay today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz soʊ du aɪ peɪ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 難免啦。那今天我還要付錢嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not that fee — the manager code fixes it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ðæt fi ðə ˈmænɪdʒər koʊd fɪksɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那筆費不用,經理代碼一改就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can just… type a code?
dialogue.zh: 你只要……打一組代碼就行?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch — there, zero. Good as promised.
dialogue.zh: 看,變零了,說到做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice save. What else should I know?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs seɪv wʌt ɛls ʃʊd aɪ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 處理得漂亮。我還該知道什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Towels cost two, or bring your own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaʊərz kɔst tu ɔr brɪŋ jɔr ˈoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 毛巾兩塊一條,或自己帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring mine. Showers — busy at six?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl brɪŋ maɪn ˈʃaʊərz ˈbɪzi æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 我自備。淋浴間六點會很擠嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pretty much. Come at ten, it's peaceful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɪti mʌtʃ kʌm æt tɛn ɪts ˈpisfəl/
dialogue.zh: 差不多。十點來就很悠閒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about parking?
dialogue.zh: 停車怎麼算?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free after five, four dollars before.
dialogue.zh: 五點後免費,五點前四塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. And lockers?
dialogue.zh: 記下了。那置物櫃呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring a lock, first floor by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ə lɑk fɜrst flɔr baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 自備鎖,放在一樓門口旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more — is a trainer free?
dialogue.zh: 最後一問,教練課是免費的嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One free session when you join.
dialogue.zh: 新會員有一堂免費的私人課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold! Where do I sign?
dialogue.zh: 就這麼說定!要在哪裡簽名?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here — name and email.
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡,姓名和信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! Can I take tonight's yoga class?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn kæn aɪ teɪk təˈnaɪts ˈjoʊɡə klæs/
dialogue.zh: 辦好了!我今晚就能去上瑜伽課嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's waiting for you, room two.
dialogue.zh: 教室正等著你,二號教室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mat, room two, ten minutes. Okay!
dialogue.zh: 墊子、二號教室,還有十分鐘,好!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've got it. First visit, huh?
dialogue.zh: 你準備好了。第一次來吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First of many, I hope. Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 希望這是許多個第一次的開頭。謝謝!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to the family — doors open!
dialogue.zh: 歡迎加入這裡,大門常開!

script.youtube_description_en:
"No gym police chasing me?" — the question everyone silently asks before joining. In this 60-line A2 listening animation, a beginner takes a gym tour and asks honest questions: opening hours, which class suits a first-timer, yearly versus month-to-month plans, freezing an account for work trips, a thirty-day cancel policy, and an enrollment-fee mix-up fixed by a manager code. Listen line by line, then repeat every sentence out loud in the shadowing chapter. Practical, funny, and packed with real membership-counter English. No memorizing — just listen often. Designed for A2 learners. Subscribe and tap the bell for a new immersive English listening animation every week!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
